title: Corn, twenty-six, from the door
logline: September 12, five days late in the box: Gully's from the door, the end stool with a plaid back on it, the tray, Gully's back at the grill, the daughter at the register. The whole shop, from the threshold, nobody's face.

panels.composition: A small shop from its door: a man in plaid from behind on the end stool with a tray of corn, a heavy gray man's back at the grill, a thirteen-year-old girl at the register from behind, the corkboard above.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small shop seen from its door with a man in plaid flannel from behind on the end stool before a tray of corn, a heavy gray man's back at a grill and a thirteen-year-old girl at the register from behind, a crowded corkboard above, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
